The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Accountant / Financial Reporting specialist to join our Finance Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help strengthen core accounting execution, audit management, and monthly consolidated results analysis while being part of a high-growth environment as we scale our financial infrastructure. If you're excited about leveraging AI and automation to redefine modern accounting with a strong focus on IFRS excellence and financial rigor, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Accounting Associate Director and work closely with teams across the Finance organisation. You will be part of a team dedicated to technical rigor and operational efficiency, partnering with cross-functional departments to elevate our accounting processes to the next level.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Accountant, you will:

  • Prepare and post journal entries, perform balance sheet reconciliations, and drive high standards for period close improving quality and speed.

  • Own the preparation of audit schedules, coordinate responses to requests, and drive the closure of audit questions to ensure a predictable, well-documented process.

  • Deep dive into monthly results, flagging risks, unusual transactions, and key movements while providing decision-ready insights for finance leadership.

  • Identify accounting risks, implement practical mitigations, and strengthen internal controls to ensure our processes are scalable and accurate.

  • Actively leverage AI tools to improve efficiency and consistency, identifying opportunities to standardise and simplify recurring accounting work.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 6+ years of experience with a strong ability to apply IFRS in real-world scenarios.

  • Comfort working with consolidated results, analysing variances, and exercising complex accounting estimates and judgments.

  • Proven experience managing audits end-to-end or acting as the primary finance contact for external auditors.

  • A track record (or clear potential) of using AI and automation to improve accounting outcomes and efficiency.

  • The ability to operate effectively in a fast-changing environment with an "ownership mindset" and excellent judgment.

  • Strong ability to translate complex accounting issues into scalable process improvements and clear insights for stakeholders.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want genuine agency at group level rather than executing instructions handed down by a central team

  • You'd rather design a process than inherit one, and you want to see your own work implemented

  • You like variety. This is a different topic most days, not a fixed monthly cycle

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You want a settled, mature environment where the process is set and the day looks the same. That's the clearest reason this role doesn't work out for people

  • You need stable priorities. It's volatile here. Several topics run at once, progress depends on other people, and priorities can change overnight

  • You want to stay inside accounting. A large part of the job is working with teams outside Finance and with external advisors in each country

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 - 12 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the Audit Readiness initiative to drive impact in our year-end execution and documentation standards.

  • Collaborate with the Finance team to embed AI-forward ways of working, automating manual workflows to increase team capacity.

  • Grow your skills in process improvements and financial analysis, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale across our legal entity markets.

  • We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger leadership projects, mastering the intersection of AI and Finance, or deepening your expertise in complex consolidated reporting.

The location

This role is hybrid (on average, 3 days a week in the office) and can be located in either our Lisbon or Madrid office.

Show me the benefits!

💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  • Hiring manager interview: A conversation with our Accounting Associate Director covering your technical accounting and IFRS experience.

  • Team panel and Pleo challenge: You'll meet the hiring manager, his manager and a peer from the team. The challenge is presented live in the session, so there's nothing to prepare or send in advance. We're looking at how you handle complexity, new areas and stakeholders.

  • Final interview: A closing conversation, used where it's helpful for both sides.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired this role, we received a lot of applications but can only interview a finite number of people. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

About your application

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

raw.title: Finance & Reconciliation Analyst / Safeguarding
raw.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Finance & Reconciliations Analyst to join our Safeguarding function at Pleo.

In this role, you'll be at the heart of how we meet our safeguarding obligations under FCA rules. You'll perform daily and periodic reconciliations across customer funds, balances and transactions, contribute to process improvement initiatives, and support our external audit activity. You'll also help produce the management information that feeds into our governance oversight. If you're genuinely curious about payments and financial infrastructure, good with data, and keen to learn and improve as you go, then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

Who you'll be working with and reporting to

You'll report to our Head of Safeguarding and work closely with teams across Finance Operations, Compliance, and Product.

Our Finance function is dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of safeguarding and financial control. You'll also have the opportunity to partner with colleagues across our operations, audit, and leadership teams to help drive strong governance and regulatory compliance.

What you'll be doing

As a Finance & Reconciliations Analyst in Safeguarding, you will:

  • Perform and support the review of daily and periodic safeguarding reconciliations across customer funds, balances and transactions

  • Monitor reconciliation outputs and carry out post-review checks and manual follow-up activity

  • Investigate breaks and exceptions, escalating where needed and tracking issues through to resolution

  • Maintain accurate records, supporting documentation and clear audit trails

  • Help collate and prepare management information on reconciliations and exceptions for governance forums including the Safeguarding Committee

  • Work with data in spreadsheets and internal systems to extract, check and present information clearly

  • Spot patterns in exceptions or recurring issues and flag them to the team

  • Contribute to reconciliations-related projects, including system changes, tooling improvements and process redesign

  • Flag inefficiencies or recurring control weaknesses and bring forward practical ideas to address them

  • Support the development and automation of reporting processes over time

  • Help prepare and organise documentation, evidence packs and reconciliation outputs for external audit

  • Respond to auditor queries and requests in a timely and accurate manner

What you bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 2+ years of experience in a reconciliations, payments, finance operations or similar role

  • Comfort working with data and spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel) and a keen interest to develop further

  • A methodical and accurate approach — you take care with the details and notice when something doesn't look right

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain what you've found clearly to colleagues and, where needed, to external auditors

  • Genuine interest in how financial services and payments regulation works in practice

  • A passion for solving problems in practical and innovative ways

  • Excellent time management and the ability to prioritise tasks effectively

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You're genuinely curious about fintech and how payments infrastructure actually works

  • You enjoy working with data and understanding systems, not just using them

  • You're excited by the responsibility of maintaining financial controls and regulatory compliance

  • You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy improving processes and ways of working

  • You bring a self-starter attitude — you don't wait to be told what to do next

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You struggle working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities

  • You do not enjoy detailed analytical or investigative work

  • You prefer working in isolation rather than collaborating with colleagues across teams

  • You're not interested in the practical application of financial regulation

How you'll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Develop a strong understanding of Pleo's safeguarding obligations under FCA rules, including the CASS and DFSA safeguarding requirements. Learn how our reconciliation processes work across all our systems and develop expertise in carrying out and reviewing reconciliations

  • Collaborate with colleagues to help improve and streamline our reconciliation and reporting processes

  • Grow your skills in data handling, financial analysis, and audit preparation

  • Take on new challenges as you build confidence and the company continues to scale

We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into process improvement leadership, or acquiring new skills in areas you identify for growth.

The location

Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background

  • Hiring Manager: A 45-minute chat with our Head of Safeguarding & Reconciliation

  • Pleo challenge: A 60-minute chat with peers and/or stakeholders to check how you would think and act in the role. Expect some real life examples as well as on the spot challenges

  • Final Interview: A 30-minute final chat with one of our senior stakeholders

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we're looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a significant number of applications but only a fraction were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn't make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Senior Supply Planner
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p>Anduril is seeking a Senior Supply Planner to join our team in Sydney, Australia. The Supply Chain team is responsible for planning and sourcing of materials to support rapidly iterating and building of cutting-edge defense hardware for autonomous underwater vehicles (AUV). You will have responsibility spanning the entire value chain from raw materials through finished goods and contributing to the strategic supply network development of Anduril’s product hardware, across their life cycles. You will have full ownership of certain assemblies and product lines, and will be ultimately responsible for sending the correct signals to Purchasing and Manufacturing on what and when to buy or build.</p> <h3>WHAT YOU'LL DO:</h3> <ul> <li>Partner with design and manufacturing engineers to accelerate product development via activities such as:</li> <ul> <li>build bottom-up cost models, using supplier data and manufacturing insight to benchmark pricing and identify cost drivers</li> <li>rapidly align on build requirements, constraints, and feasibility against schedule</li> <li>Perform impact assessment on build schedule when change reviews are proposed and implemented</li> </ul> <li>Own and maintain the line of balance (LOB) for assigned programs, ensuring material availability is synchronised to the master build schedule. You'll be the connective tissue between procurement, production, and engineering — translating build requirements into actionable supply plans and driving resolution when gaps threaten schedule</li> <li>Drive and support clear-to-build (CTB) reviews ahead of each build phase, confirming all materials, long-lead items, and supplier deliverables are on hand or on track</li> <li>Collaborate with procurement to expedite, re-sequence, or source alternatives when supply risks emerge, escalating early with data-backed recommendations</li> <li>Track and report schedule adherence metrics (OTD, CTB pass rate, LOB health) and drive root cause analysis on misses.</li> <li>Maintain MRP/ERP system accuracy — planned orders, lead times, safety stock parameters, and demand signals aligned to current program baselines.</li> <li>Support all cost engineering activities to converge the bottoms-up cost curve to product cost, maximizing the total cost of ownership (TCO) across the product lifecycle</li> <li>Support new product introduction (NPI) builds by developing initial supply plans from early-stage BOMs and engineering change orders.</li> </ul> <h3>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:</h3> <ul> <li>Ideally has background within:</li> <ul> <li>7+ years in supply planning, production planning, or materials management within a complex hardware manufacturing environment, preferably defence or aerospace.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience managing line of balance and clear-to-build processes across multi-level BOMs with long-lead and constrained materials.</li> <li>Track record of maintaining build schedule adherence in a rate production or NPI environment.Design &amp; development of electronics and/or mechanical devices</li> <li>Advanced supply planning experience, including stints in production planning, materials management, or master scheduling roles</li> </ul> <li>Familiarity with developing high-tech products in a high-mix, low-volume environment</li> <li>Prior knowledge of Oracle or a similar Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or a related field. Professional certifications such as CPIM, CSCP, or CPSM, or an advanced degree, are strongly preferred</li> <li>Eligible to obtain and maintain an Australian Government Negative Vetting 2 security clearance (NV2)</li> </ul> <h3>Soft Skills and Leadership:</h3> <ul> <li>Strong communication skills — ability to present material risk and recovery plans to program managers and senior leadership with clarity and confidence.</li> <li>Comfort operating in ambiguity, particularly during early-stage programs where BOMs are evolving and requirements are fluid.</li> <li>Collaborative mindset with a bias for action — someone who chases answers rather than waiting for them.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-contrast="auto">The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335551550&quot;:0,&quot;335551620&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 class="detailElios"><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.&nbsp;</span><em><span data-contrast="auto">For more information, <a href="https://www.anduril.com/careers">Explore Our Benefits</a>.</span></em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <div class="RichText column1"> <h3 class="detailElios"><strong>Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams</strong></h3> <p class="detailElios">Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. title: Principal Radio Frequency Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 id="isPasted"><strong>Company Overview</strong></h3> <p>Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.</p> <p>Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.</p> <p>At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.</p> <p>Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.</p></div><h3><strong>Group&nbsp;Overview</strong></h3> <p>Electromagnetic and Cyber Group (EM&amp;C) is responsible for developing flexible and survivable advanced electronic warfare and secure communications equipment while providing the industry’s leading signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and cyber experts. Metrea specialises in signal classification, direction finding, advanced geolocation techniques, and waveform development including waveforms for MANET and LPI/LPD applications. Metrea also develops special purpose radios for government customers and licenses DF and geolocation solutions to multiple OEMs.</p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">The Expeditionary Operations Lab, or EXOLAB, focuses on the rapid development, integration, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">evaluation</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and delivery of expeditionary capabilities within the Electromagnetic Warfare and Cyber domain.</span> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">EXOLAB works across research and development, experimentation, prototyping, systems integration, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">trials</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and operational delivery. The team addresses complex customer problems by combining existing technologies, emerging </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">capabilities</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and internally developed solutions into deployable systems.</span> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">The lab </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">operates</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> across airborne, land, maritime and dismounted environments, with a strong emphasis on practical engineering, rapid learning and delivering systems that are operationally relevant, </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8">supportable</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW239653401 BCX8"> and resilient.</span></span><span class="EOP Selected SCXW239653401 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <h3><strong>Position Summary</strong></h3> <p>We are seeking a Principal RF Engineer to lead and support the research, design, development, integration and delivery of radio-frequency systems for expeditionary Electronic Warfare, signals intelligence, spectrum operations and secure communications capabilities.&nbsp;</p> <p>The role will be responsible for the RF engineering aspects of prototype and operational systems, including RF architecture, receiver and transmitter chains, antenna systems, signal distribution, filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, interference management and system performance analysis.&nbsp;</p> <p>The Principal RF Engineer will operate as a senior technical authority within a multidisciplinary team comprising electrical, systems, mechanical, software, cyber and operational specialists. The role will support the full engineering lifecycle, from concept development and technology evaluation through detailed design, integration, verification, trials, deployment and through-life support.&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a practical, delivery-focused engineering role. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between theoretical analysis, simulation, laboratory testing, prototype development, platform integration and field trials.&nbsp;</p> <p>The role will be based either in Lincoln or London, with a longer-term intent to transition the primary location to London if hired initially in Lincoln.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Design, develop and integrate RF systems for expeditionary Unmanned Systems control, Electronic Warfare, signals intelligence, spectrum-monitoring and secure communications capabilities.&nbsp;</span><span description: Who are we? Smarkets: Predicting the Future of Betting Smarkets is a prediction market exchange for sports and political trading, having handled over $50 billion in volume since 2010. We're upending sports betting with the fairest prices, the best technology, and a superior customer experience, powered by attracting great people and building a high-performance environment where they thrive. We're looking for an atypical candidate with strong regulated-business experience to support our growing CFTC business. The Team Security sits within Infrastructure and Engineering, protecting the distributed, real-time systems behind our trading engine. The team's remit spans our core products and our DCM/DCO entities, with a real regulatory dimension to the work, particularly around our CFTC-regulated business units. Alongside that regulatory scope, the focus is squarely on hands-on engineering: designing, building, and shipping the security tooling and controls that let engineering teams move fast safely. About the Role: This is a founding build. You'll stand up security engineering from the ground up through go-live and mature it as we scale, working within Infrastructure and Engineering teams to build the controls, automation, and guardrails our trading systems and regulated entities need. What you will do: Build the Foundations: Be part of a founding build, standing up security engineering from the ground up through go-live and maturing it as we scale, working within Infrastructure and Engineering teams. Design Guardrails: Design, build, and deploy security controls and guardrails across cloud-native platforms, including AI security solutions protecting customer-facing and internal products. Automate as Code: Automate security processes as code, embedding compliance and infrastructure-as-code checks into CI/CD pipelines without slowing down frequent shipping. Assess & Remediate: Conduct risk audits and assessments, translating findings into practical recommendations for engineering teams, and be hands-on in implementing those recommendations. Monitor & Respond: Monitor and analyse system access logs, flag anomalies, and support incident response, containment, and post-incident root cause analysis. Plan for Resilience: Plan and test security backups and disaster recovery processes to keep the platform resilient. Maintain Compliance: Develop and maintain security policies, standards, and controls meeting DCM/DCO requirements, and maintain evidence and documentation to support regulatory examinations and audits. Partner Across Teams: Partner with business and engineering teams on solutions, translating technical work for product and engineering audiences. Champion Ownership: Build a culture of security ownership among engineers, acting as a security partner rather than a gatekeeper. Role Requirements: Security Engineering Background: Hands-on experience building security engineering/DevSecOps capabilities in a cloud-native, high-growth environment, ideally financial services or exchange infrastructure. Confident Communicator: Comfortable communicating security risk, controls and technical decisions verbally and in writing to external stakeholders such as auditors or regulators. Regulatory Familiarity: Familiarity with CFTC system safeguards expectations, including 17 C.F.R. § 38.1051 and § 39.18 or similar regulatory requirements. AppSec Foundations: Strong grasp of application security principles (OWASP Top 10, NIST) and secure SDLC practices. CI/CD & Tooling: Proficiency with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, CircleCI) and security tools (Snyk, Aqua, Trivy, Checkov, Twistlock, Clair). Cloud & Container Security: Hands-on expertise securing AWS/Azure/GCP, Kubernetes, containers, and IaC. Compliance as Code: Working knowledge of infrastructure-as-code and compliance-as-code practices. Automation Proficiency: Proficiency in at least one of Python, Bash, or Go, with a track record of automating security processes. Nice-to-have: Demonstrated experience deploying AI security solutions, guardrails, and defences for AI systems used by customers; a personal interest in sports, exchanges, or trading; certifications such as DSOP, CKS, CISSP, CCSP, CSSLP, or an AWS/Azure/GCP Security Specialty; a track record of security automation at scale in Agile/Scrum environments; direct experience with regulators/examiners on technology and system safeguards; and familiarity with event contracts, prediction markets, or similar novel futures products under CFTC. Our Values Our values are at the heart of everything we do, guiding how we work, collaborate, and innovate. Be a Pro: We take ownership, act with integrity, and consistently deliver to a high standard. Bring the Energy: We bring positivity, curiosity, and enthusiasm to everything we do, inspiring those around us. Culture Fit: These values define how we succeed as a team. If this isn't you, this may not be the right place. We hire people who thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and ambitious environment. Perks & Benefits We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, alongside a dynamic, collaborative environment where your work truly makes an impact and your voice is heard. Our team is diverse, driven, and ambitious, united by a strong work ethic and a hunger to innovate and win. Our benefits are designed around Health, Wealth, and Development, supporting you both professionally and personally. These include: Stock Options: Vest over 4 years, your success is our success. Pension Scheme: Competitive plan via Aviva, with up to 6% matched contributions if you opt in. Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to keep you and your family healthy. Enhanced Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave to support you through life's most important moments. Stay Fuelled: Enjoy fresh, chef-made breakfast and lunch every day, plus a constant supply of fruit, snacks, tea, coffee and soft drinks, because great work starts with great food. Cycle-to-Work Scheme: Support for sustainable commuting and staying active. Learning & Development: £1,000 annual education budget for courses, conferences, books, or training. Holiday: 25 days paid leave plus bank holidays, with the option to carry over 5 days. Flexible Working: Hybrid model with 3 days in the office and 2 days from home to fit your lifestyle.   • Design Guardrails: Design, build, and deploy security controls and guardrails across cloud-native platforms, including AI security solutions protecting customer-facing and internal products.

Partner Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with product, trading, data, and commercial teams to align marketing with the wider business roadmap. D2C Experience: Real experience growing a D2C/consumer business where you owned the relationship with the customer directly. Multiple markets: Has successfully executed a marketing strategy for multiple geographic or cultural regions. Efficient Growth: A demonstrable record of growing a business through efficient acquisition; we want to see strong ROI, not just big spend. Full-Funnel Fluency: You've owned brand, performance acquisition, and retention, and understand how they compound. Who are we?

Smarkets: Predicting the Future of Betting

Smarkets runs one of the world's most sophisticated prediction markets, handling over £29 billion in volume since 2010 and engaging 200,000+ traders globally. We're a technology company that happens to revolutionise betting, from sports to political markets, to delivering the sharpest prices and the fairest odds.

At the heart of our success are our people. We create a high-performance environment where exceptional talent can thrive, blending deep business experience with a commercial mindset to drive strategic growth.

If you're ready to help shape the future of prediction markets with cutting-edge technology and a customer-first philosophy, Smarkets is where you belong.

We welcome applications from candidates who are genuinely energised by the challenge of building a brand and a growth engine at scale, and who have the track record to prove it. We look forward to reviewing your application.

The Team

This role sits at the heart of our commercial strategy, overseeing marketing teams and working shoulder-to-shoulder with product, trading, data, and the executive team to grow the business. Prediction markets and exchange products are having a moment, and the team's job is to capture that energy: building the Smarkets brand and the brands within our group, and making every pound of the marketing budget work harder than the last.

About the Role:

As our VP Commercial & Marketing, you'll be responsible for every marketing lever we have: brand, acquisition, and retention, across multiple markets, including UK and US. Your team will be accountable for how the world discovers Smarkets and the brands within our group, why they choose us over anyone else, and why they stay.

We're looking for a senior leader who has scaled a direct-to-consumer brand before and understands the pitfalls and opportunities. We need someone who will set the strategy for marketing and roll up their sleeves to execute. If you want to direct from a distance, this isn't the role for you. If you want to own the number, build up the team, and be measured on the growth you deliver, read on.

You will own the marketing budget, and we'll expect you to make every pound work harder than the last. Success looks like ROI and disciplined scaling; failure looks like vanity spend that fails to deliver the unit economics. This role reports to the COO and sits at the heart of our commercial strategy.

What you will do:

  • Own the Strategy: Own a multi-jurisdiction marketing strategy end-to-end, accountable for design and execution across brand, acquisition, and retention.

  • Shape Go-to-Market: Help develop the commercial strategy for go-to-market projects and our core brands.

  • Deliver ROI: Accountable for effective ROI on the annual marketing budget.

  • Build the Team: Mentor and develop a high-performing marketing team, raising the bar on talent and standards.

  • Scale Performance Marketing: Build the processes to scale performance marketing across paid channels, relentlessly improving CAC, ROAS, and payback.

  • Sharpen the Brand: Sharpen and grow the Smarkets brand: our positioning, our voice, and how we show up in a crowded market.

  • Drive Retention: Develop the retention and lifecycle strategy, turning first-time users into loyal, high-value traders through CRM and lifecycle marketing.

  • Own the Metrics: Define the metrics that matter, hold the team to them, and make decisions grounded in data.

  • Partner Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with product, trading, data, and commercial teams to align marketing with the wider business roadmap.

Role Requirements:

  • Proven Brand Builder: A senior marketing leader with a proven track record of scaling a brand.

  • D2C Experience: Real experience growing a D2C/consumer business where you owned the relationship with the customer directly.

  • Multiple markets: Has successfully executed a marketing strategy for multiple geographic or cultural regions.

  • Efficient Growth: A demonstrable record of growing a business through efficient acquisition; we want to see strong ROI, not just big spend.

  • Full-Funnel Fluency: You've owned brand, performance acquisition, and retention, and understand how they compound.

  • Genuinely Data-Driven: You live in the metrics (CAC, LTV, ROAS, payback) and use them to make hard calls.

  • Builder and Operator: Hands-on, decisive, and energised by getting things done rather than delegating them away.

  • Communicator: Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across a fast-moving, cross-functional business.

  • Nice-to-have: Experience in sports, sports betting, or gaming is a strong plus.

Our Values

Our values are at the heart of everything we do, guiding how we work, collaborate, and innovate. They reflect what we expect of ourselves and each other to deliver the best results, while fostering a positive, high-performing environment:

  • Push to Win: We set ambitious goals and relentlessly pursue them, always striving for excellence.

  • Make Others Better: We lift each other up, share knowledge, and celebrate team success over individual achievement.

  • Give a Shit: We care deeply about our work, our users, and the impact we make.

  • Be a Pro: We take ownership, act with integrity, and consistently deliver to a high standard.

  • Bring the Energy: We bring positivity, curiosity, and enthusiasm to everything we do, inspiring those around us.

Culture Fit: These values define how we succeed as a team. If this isn't you, this may not be the right place. We hire people who thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and ambitious environment.

Perks & Benefits

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, alongside a dynamic, collaborative environment where your work truly makes an impact and your voice is heard. Our team is diverse, driven, and ambitious, united by a strong work ethic and a hunger to innovate and win.

You'll report directly to the CEO and work closely with both founders and every functional leader.

This is not a conventional Chief of Staff, strategy-only, or back-office finance role. It's a builder-operator role for someone who takes full ownership of results and uses AI and automation to remove manual work wherever possible.

Finance and Reporting:

  • Own the budget, rolling forecast, cash, runway, and scenario planning — giving leadership a clear, trusted view of the company's financial position and future needs.

  • Build a trusted view of ARR, bookings, retention, gross margin, burn, headcount, and unit economics, with clear definitions and reconciled data sources.

  • Oversee billing, collections, payroll coordination, expenses, procurement, and vendors, while putting practical controls in place to keep Airspeed ready for fundraising, audit, tax, and diligence.

     

AI, Automation, and Systems:

  • Make Airspeed AI-native in how we operate, not only in what we sell — redesigning recurring workflows with AI agents, automation tools, APIs, and lightweight code.

  • Build dependable operating systems with clean data, exception handling, audit trails, and human approval where needed, and create self-serve workflows that don't depend on you becoming the human router for every request.

  • Measure the impact of automation through speed, accuracy, reporting latency, and manual hours removed, while helping teams use AI safely with sensitive data and high-stakes decisions.

  • Provide inputs for Supplier / Subcontractor quality requirements for Proposals, and Contracts.

  • Incoming

  • Key stages of manufacturing, assembly, integration & testing.

  • Before release to customers or next integration phase.

Nonconformance Management

  • Support the detection, documentation and containment of nonconformances.

  • Assist in Material Review Board (MRB) activities and follow up on rework or repair implementation and verification.

  • Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective/preventive actions in coordination with engineering and MAIT.

Quality Assurance support in MAIT Operations:

  • Provide day-to-day quality support to MAIT.

  • Review and approve MAIT procedures.

  • Monitor and enforce compliance with internal procedures, customer requirements, space and aerospace quality standards (e.g., AS9100).

  • Qualification of Special processes based in EN9100 (e.g: welding, Non-Destructive Testing, etc). Desirable experience with welding.

  • Train MAIT staff on quality procedures and best practices.

  • Calibration coordination.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Lead quality improvement projects to enhance process stability and product quality.

  • Collaborate with design, manufacturing, and supply chain teams to improve product quality.

  • Analyze quality data and generate reports to track trends and identify areas for improvement.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field.

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in a quality assurance role, preferably in aerospace, space, defense, or other high-reliability manufacturing environments.

  • Knowledge of quality standards (e.g., EN/AS9100, ISO 9001).

  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, inspection techniques (visual, dimensional, electrical), and GD&T.

  • Experience with nonconformance management systems and root cause analysis tools (e.g., 8D, 5-Whys, Ishikawa).

raw.description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the AI-native ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

This huge market is ours to take. We’ve raised $200M+ from Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need

We are building industry-defining accounting and finance software. We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Deployment Lead to join our team and help lead the successful onboarding of new customers onto Rillet.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong accounting foundation who is excited to work directly with customers and help finance teams modernize how they operate. You may come from Big 4 audit, accounting advisory, finance transformation, or an operational accounting role at a high-growth technology company. You do not need to have formally led ERP implementations before, but you do need to be systems-minded, highly organized, customer-oriented, and eager to learn quickly in a fast-paced startup environment.

We’re primarily looking for teammates who are based near our New York City or San Francisco offices, or open to relocating. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States. Our hybrid schedule brings office-based team members together in person on Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day each week. Some roles may spend more time in the office depending on the needs of the team.

What You'll Do

  • Lead key parts of customer onboarding and deployment, helping ensure a smooth and timely implementation experience

  • Partner with internal teams across Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to execute implementation plans and solve customer problems quickly

  • Learn and analyze client accounting and finance workflows, then translate those needs into clear requirements and practical solutions

  • Guide customers through onboarding, training, change management, and adoption

  • Support data migration, reconciliations, systems setup, and integration coordination

  • Track milestones, drive follow-through, and keep internal and external stakeholders aligned throughout the onboarding process

  • Identify risks early, escalate issues quickly, and help keep customer launches on track

  • Build trust with customers by being responsive, thoughtful, and solutions-oriented

  • Maintain clear documentation and provide regular status updates to customers and internal stakeholders

Who We're Looking For

  • 4-7 years of experience in accounting, audit, advisory, or related customer-facing roles

  • Strong accounting foundation, with the ability to speak credibly about close, reconciliations, revenue recognition (ASC 606), and core finance workflows

  • Excellent communication skills and the presence to work directly with customers and senior stakeholders

  • Systems-minded and excited to learn implementation work, even if you have not formally held an implementation title before

  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams at once

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high attention to detail

  • Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams

  • Experience in Big 4, SaaS or at a technology company is a plus

Tier B: $100,000 – $140,000
Tier C: $100,000 – $130,000

description: Chief of Staff for Engineering About Us Parity is one of the world's most experienced companies building the core infrastructure behind blockchain - the system that allows information and value to be shared securely without needing an intermediary. We're laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services. About the Team This role sits at the heart of Parity's leadership, working directly with our Founder to drive organisational alignment and execution across the company. About the Role You will work directly with Gavin Wood, Parity's Founder. Your job is to take his vision, goals and ideas, and turn them into clear decisions, aligned teams, and forward momentum. You will think 12 to 24 months ahead, not just manage what is on fire today. You understand that the decisions made now impact the future, and you treat them accordingly. You will be a key partner to Directors across the business, our CEO, and the primary bridge between Gavin's priorities and the Acceleration team's execution. What You'll Do Operate as Founder's technical right hand. You will manage his context, his priorities, and his follow-through. You are available when it matters. You anticipate what he needs before he asks for it. Turn chaos into clarity. Parity moves fast. You will work in an environment of competing half-thoughts, ambiguous mandates, and shifting priorities. Your job is to impose structure without killing momentum, and to spot the counterproductive plays before they cause damage. Think long. You will not just solve today's problem. You will map the second- and third-order consequences of decisions being made now and make sure the right people are thinking about them. Lead cross-functional problem solving. When something falls between departments, you pick it up. You have the technical credibility to engage with engineering leadership and the operational instinct to get things moving. Own the leadership rhythm. OKRs, technical reviews, decision-making cadences, you design and run the operating system for Gavin's leadership team. Manage up, across, and down. You will work with C-Level and Directors across different Functions of the business. Each is different. You will adapt your communication style to each of them without losing your own voice. Your Skills Technically credible. You have a background in engineering or engineering management. You can hold your own with a CTO, challenge timelines credibly, and evaluate the viability of new technical initiatives. You do not need to be a Blockchain Engineer, but you understand the ecosystem well enough to distinguish substance from hype. A sophisticated operator. You have run complex, cross-functional programmes at a senior level, ideally having led a team or founded a company. You know how to create clarity from ambiguity, manage without authority, and drive decisions in organisations that do not move in straight lines. Experience managing leaders, including more junior managers, is a strong signal. Exceptional communicator. Not just clear, adaptive. You can shift registers between a demanding Founder, Functions Leads, and a junior team member. You know what each person needs to hear and how they need to hear it. A long-term thinker. You are not a damage limitation operator. You think about what the decisions being made today mean in 12 to 24 months. You bring that perspective into rooms where others are only looking at this quarter. Believes in Web3. You do not need deep protocol experience. But you need to understand why this technology matters and be genuinely curious about where it is going. Candidates who are indifferent to the mission do not last here. Thrives in ambiguity. Parity is not a machine. It is a high-conviction, fast-moving organisation with a demanding founder. You find that energising, not exhausting. Academically strong. A high-calibre degree matters. If you have one, lead with it. If you don't, your track record needs to be exceptional. About Working With Us Joining Parity means joining teammates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! raw.description:
Chief of Staff for Engineering

About Us

Parity is one of the world's most experienced companies building the core infrastructure behind blockchain - the system that allows information and value to be shared securely without needing an intermediary. We're laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services.

Our remote-first, global team develop open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot, Polkadot SDK, and Kusama — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet.Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications.

About the Team

This role sits at the heart of Parity's leadership, working directly with our Founder to drive organisational alignment and execution across the company.

About the Role

You will work directly with Gavin Wood, Parity's Founder. Your job is to take his vision, goals and ideas, and turn them into clear decisions, aligned teams, and forward momentum. You will think 12 to 24 months ahead, not just manage what is on fire today. You understand that the decisions made now impact the future, and you treat them accordingly.

You will be a key partner to Directors across the business, our CEO, and the primary bridge between Gavin's priorities and the Acceleration team's execution.

What You'll Do

  • Operate as Founder's technical right hand. You will manage his context, his priorities, and his follow-through. You are available when it matters. You anticipate what he needs before he asks for it.

  • Turn chaos into clarity. Parity moves fast. You will work in an environment of competing half-thoughts, ambiguous mandates, and shifting priorities. Your job is to impose structure without killing momentum, and to spot the counterproductive plays before they cause damage.

  • Think long. You will not just solve today's problem. You will map the second- and third-order consequences of decisions being made now and make sure the right people are thinking about them.

  • Lead cross-functional problem solving. When something falls between departments, you pick it up. You have the technical credibility to engage with engineering leadership and the operational instinct to get things moving.

  • Own the leadership rhythm. OKRs, technical reviews, decision-making cadences, you design and run the operating system for Gavin's leadership team.

  • Manage up, across, and down. You will work with C-Level and Directors across different Functions of the business. Each is different. You will adapt your communication style to each of them without losing your own voice.

Your Skills

  • Technically credible. You have a background in engineering or engineering management. You can hold your own with a CTO, challenge timelines credibly, and evaluate the viability of new technical initiatives. You do not need to be a Blockchain Engineer, but you understand the ecosystem well enough to distinguish substance from hype.

  • A sophisticated operator. You have run complex, cross-functional programmes at a senior level, ideally having led a team or founded a company. You know how to create clarity from ambiguity, manage without authority, and drive decisions in organisations that do not move in straight lines. Experience managing leaders, including more junior managers, is a strong signal.

  • Exceptional communicator. Not just clear, adaptive. You can shift registers between a demanding Founder, Functions Leads, and a junior team member. You know what each person needs to hear and how they need to hear it.

  • A long-term thinker. You are not a damage limitation operator. You think about what the decisions being made today mean in 12 to 24 months. You bring that perspective into rooms where others are only looking at this quarter.

  • Believes in Web3. You do not need deep protocol experience. But you need to understand why this technology matters and be genuinely curious about where it is going. Candidates who are indifferent to the mission do not last here.

  • Thrives in ambiguity. Parity is not a machine. It is a high-conviction, fast-moving organisation with a demanding founder. You find that energising, not exhausting.

  • Academically strong. A high-calibre degree matters. If you have one, lead with it. If you don't, your track record needs to be exceptional.

Joining Parity means joining teammates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! You’ll work remotely and flexibly, while still getting to meet your teammates throughout the year at team and company-wide retreats.

Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information, please visit<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><a class="ms-outlook-linkify" href="http://www.vml.com/" data-outlook-id="fbec6e7f-765e-41de-af7b-a3ef743f9886"><u>www.vml.com</u></a><u>&nbsp;</u>and follow along on <a href="https://urldefense.proofpoint.com/v2/url?u=https-3A__urldefense.com_v3_-5F-5Fhttps-3A_www.linkedin.com_company_vml_-5F-5F-3B-21-21JboVxjCXSME-21OhlpCfbkl1UcWPwns1-2DGtvHOzFh0QwHV49fsPgGw-2DVCCU1bCg8aQFI9vN-2Dy-2DVwaQcITH2j2XKzGKBIFRLYf2AUWVYY1dFGK6-24&amp;d=DwMFaQ&amp;c=euGZstcaTDllvimEN8b7jXrwqOf-v5A_CdpgnVfiiMM&amp;r=zouFnm4jZMgDFaYF1uVcRY3rbgHWPca_luUrBUkT6Yc&amp;m=QzcCgXCAOjzj5hiU48_CKOdHRSJ4_YpuqfviT9yjlzH5VrkzySTZ-WaQXlYAnj4W&amp;s=jJ7q5V70u9oUx7ONPm5jC3IK8y6vxDilX6BGTlqlWlA&amp;e=" data-outlook-id="b89e4621-22a7-4a88-a5da-c6ecc3a722be"><u>LinkedIn</u></a>&nbsp;#WeAreVML.</p></div><p>Nous recrutons, pour renforcer nos équipes Sales, un.e Head of B2B &amp; Energy.</p> <p><strong>Missions</strong></p> <p>En tant que Head of B2B &amp; Energy, vous portez le développement de VML Consulting sur les marchés B2B et sur le secteur de l’énergie (énergéticiens, utilities, acteurs de la transition énergétique et de la mobilité). Vous incarnez une posture de vente “architecte” : comprendre des enjeux clients transverses – commerciaux, opérationnels, data, technologiques, réglementaires – et y répondre en orchestrant des équipes pluridisciplinaires. Comme l’ensemble de l’équipe de Business Développement, vous reposez sur un profil hybride dont les 2 piliers sont d’être :</p> <ul> <li>Responsable de bout en bout du parcours d’avant-vente et de vente de nos offres et de nos <em>capabilities </em>auprès de clients et prospects,</li> <li>Consultant ou directeur de mission, mobilisant une compréhension fine des enjeux B2B et énergie pour structurer des réponses transverses et activer les bonnes expertises (métier, data, technologique, créative) au sein de VML Consulting et du réseau WPP.</li> </ul> <p>Cette hybridation, couplée à une posture “architecte”, est la clé du succès : être à la fois expert de la vente complexe, capable de lire des enjeux clients transverses, et en maîtrise des pans complets du métier du conseil et de l’agence.</p> <p><em>Dimension Business :</em></p> <ul> <li>Définit et déploie la stratégie de go-to-market de VML Consulting sur les marchés B2B et le secteur de l’énergie, afin d’en faire l’acteur le plus attractif, singulier et impactant,</li> <li>Construit et anime un plan de comptes ciblé (énergéticiens, utilities, grands comptes B2B) pour maintenir une intensité relationnelle élevée auprès des décideurs, défendre notre positionnement et détecter les opportunités de croissance,</li> <li>Pilote, en posture d’architecte, la construction de propositions adressant des enjeux transverses : cadre la problématique client, structure la réponse et orchestre les Business Units et expertises (data, conseil, technologie, créatif) nécessaires à sa conversion,</li> <li>Met en œuvre, en continue, l’excellence du parcours de vente via les processus et les outils internes à des fins de visibilité, de pilotage et d’animation globale de la démarche commerciale en interne,</li> <li>Sécurise et défend les intérêts économique et contractuel de VML Consulting dans le cadre de la vente et après celle-ci,</li> <li>Assure un suivi régulier des prestations et des relations avec les clients donneur d’ordres et les opérationnels pour s’assurer de l’adéquation de la prestation avec le besoin, et identifier des opportunités de suite ou d’extension de la mission,</li> <li>Contribue au thought leadership de VML Consulting sur les enjeux B2B et énergie (transition énergétique, décarbonation, expérience client B2B, data), via des prises de parole valorisant nos convictions et nos réussites dans une logique de ROI business,</li> <li>Construit et fait vivre un patrimoine de connaissances sur les marchés B2B et le secteur de l’énergie (acteurs, enjeux réglementaires, dynamiques de marché) afin d’accélérer et de fluidifier l’action commerciale,</li> <li>Incarne, diffuse et fait vivre l’excellence commerciale en interne, en particulier auprès de la communauté managériale pour l’inspirer, la faire progresser et développer ses appétences et son niveau d’impact business.</li> </ul> <p><em>Dimension Conseil :</em></p> <ul> <li>Réalise, seul ou en équipe, des missions de conseil sur les sujets B2B et énergie, afin de maintenir un haut niveau de crédibilité et de légitimité dans la dimension Business,</li> <li>Pilote des missions de conseil, sur l’ensemble des composantes&nbsp;: qualité des livrables, respects des plannings et des engagements, tenue de l’équilibre budgétaire,</li> <li>Fait évoluer son savoir-faire et ses connaissances via une veille continue sur les sujets qui comptent pour nos clients et prospects, mais aussi des formations et sa curiosité,</li> <li>Maîtrise et met en œuvre toute la chaîne de production d’une mission de la prise de commande au recouvrement, pour assurer performance opérationnelle complète,</li> <li>Manage des équipes pluridisciplinaires de consultants dans le cadre des missions, et assure une coordination et une information continue de sa hiérarchie pour permettre un feedback constructif et le développement des compétences,</li> <li>Garantit la capitalisation du savoir et des livrables sur ses missions, et partage des retours d’expérience autant que de besoin.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Profil recherché</strong></p> <p>Vous justifiez de 7 à 15 ans d’expérience, dont un parcours significatif en cabinet de conseil (stratégie, transformation ou conseil opérationnel). Une expérience des marchés B2B et/ou du secteur de l’énergie (énergéticiens, utilities, transition énergétique) est un atout déterminant.</p> <p>Notre métier consistant à vendre et réaliser des missions mobilisant une grande diversité de compétences (data, conseil, créatif, technologique), vous avez développé une véritable appétence pour la vente “architecte” : savoir lire des enjeux clients transverses et y répondre en mobilisant des équipes pluridisciplinaires.</p> <p>Vous pouvez justifier de contributions ou de succès significatifs dans le cadre d’initiatives business, au-delà d’en comprendre la logique ou les bonnes pratiques.</p> <p>Votre capacité à nouer des relations de grande qualité avec des décideurs – Directions Générales, Directions Commerciales et B2B, Directions Marketing, Directions de la Transition Énergétique, Directions des Opérations ou DSI – fait de vous un acteur à l’aise et performant, de la découverte du besoin à la conclusion d’un deal équilibrant les intérêts du client et de VML Consulting.</p> <p>Les enjeux des marchés B2B et du secteur de l’énergie vous passionnent, et vous savez vous appuyer sur vos expériences pour bâtir un discours solide en avant-vente comme en mission.</p> <p>Votre rigueur et votre curiosité font de vous un acteur à la fois à l’aise dans la logique de développement business sur des clients existants que sur de la conquête opportuniste, ou en relai d’un partenaire.</p> <p>La maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, est indispensable : vous adressez des clients et des interlocuteurs internationaux de manière totalement autonome.</p> <p><strong>Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.</strong></p> <p><strong>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</strong></p> <p>Intégrer VML Consulting, c’est choisir d’évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, humain et innovant, propice au développement de chacun, à la réalisation de missions enrichissantes et aux évolutions de carrière. Nous rejoindre, c’est participer à une aventure collective au service de l’épanouissement personnel.</p> <p>Nous menons à bien notre projet d’entreprise sans sacrifier nos valeurs :</p> <ul> <li>Un positionnement clair</li> <li>Le respect de chacun</li> <li>L’engagement auprès de nos clients</li> <li>L’épanouissement professionnel et l’entente entre collaborateurs</li> </ul> <p>Vous partagez ces valeurs, rejoignez-nous !</p> <p>#LI-EMEA</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span class="normaltextrun"><span lang="EN-GB"><span lang="EN-GB">We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. raw.description:
About Cartesia

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

Overview

We are seeking native-level French speakers with a linguistics background to serve as the primary language resource for voice AI in their language. You will be the trusted point of contact for all questions, quality decisions, and language-specific work related to French.

This is not a standard annotation engagement. You will own your language end to end, which includes managing annotation quality, auditing data, monitoring product performance, investigating customer-reported issues, and executing projects that require deep linguistic expertise and attention to detail. You will operate independently across these workstreams and serve as the team's go-to resource for anything related to your language.

This is an ongoing contractor engagement. Availability during some US Pacific business hours is preferred to allow for team syncs and real-time support.

 

About the Engagement

You will coordinate with the Human Evals Manager on project deliverables and timelines. Some examples of what your day-to-day work may include:

  • Answer questions from annotators about guidelines, edge cases, or language-specific issues via an agreed project communication channel.

  • Cascade new feedback, instructions, or rubric updates to annotators working on your projects.

  • Listen to annotator-rated audio files and check whether their ratings and written feedback align with the rubric.

  • Prepare written quality assessments for annotators with specific examples and recommendations.

  • Listen to TTS output and provide ground truth assessments of pronunciation, prosody, and naturalness in your language.

  • Update or expand sections of the annotation guidelines when you find gaps or edge cases.

  • Prep and run calibration meetings with annotators.

  • Hold office hours on a mutually agreed schedule during active studies so annotators can ask questions in real time.

  • Develop onboarding materials and resources for new annotators.

  • Write QA reports on annotation quality and calibration outcomes.

  • Review production audio in your language and flag quality issues to the team.

  • Investigate language-specific issues reported by customers and identify root causes.

  • Audit datasets for linguistic accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

     

Commitment

Roughly 40 hours per week with flexibility in scheduling. Project hours may vary depending on active studies, data projects, and product needs. Participation in periodic coordination meetings during US Pacific hours is expected.

 

Requirements

  • Native-level proficiency in French as spoken in France.

  • Experience with data annotation, transcription, or language quality assurance.

  • Strong foundation in linguistics or a related field, with the ability to apply concepts like phonetics, prosody, and intonation when evaluating speech and writing annotation guidelines.

  • Strong written English proficiency. All guidelines, feedback, reports, and team communication are in English.

  • Ability to write clear, structured instructions and deliver specific, actionable feedback to annotators.

  • Comfortable working with data and metrics such as inter-rater agreement scores, audit spreadsheets, and structured feedback templates.

  • Self-directed and able to manage feedback cycles, QA reviews, and data projects without close oversight.

Preferred

  • Experience writing or maintaining annotation guidelines or rubrics.

  • Experience training, mentoring, or managing other annotators.

  • Experience with audio evaluation, TTS, or STT.

  • Conversational spoken English proficiency for meetings and calibration syncs.

  • Experience working with distributed, remote teams.


This is a 1099 contract opportunity and will not be eligible for the benefits below. Language Leads work on an ongoing basis, renewable by mutual agreement. You will control your own methods for completing assigned work, supply your own equipment, and are responsible for your own taxes. You must be authorized to work in your country of residence.

 

Note: Cartesia participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I-9 information to confirm employment eligibility after hire.

More Details

🏢 In-office policy: We’re an in-person team based out of offices in 🇺🇸 San Francisco, 🇬🇧 London and 🇮🇳 Bangalore. We love being in the office, hanging out together, and learning from each other every day.

🌎 Visa sponsorship: We provide visa sponsorship support and assess each circumstance on a case-by-case basis. However, visa sponsorship is dependent on many factors, including the role you are applying for, and the location you are going to be based, and so we can't always guarantee success. Your Recruiter will work with you to understand your visa sponsorship needs from the first call.

🚢 We ship fast. All of our work is novel and cutting edge, and execution speed is paramount. We have a high bar, and we don’t sacrifice quality or design along the way.

🤝 We support each other. We have an open & inclusive culture that’s focused on giving everyone the resources they need to succeed.

Our Benefits (US Employees Only)

💰 Compensation Competitive base salary alongside attractive equity package.

🩺 Health Insurance Fully covered medical insurance along with dental and vision for you and your family.

🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Parental Leave 9 weeks paternity & 12 weeks maternity leave

🏦 401(k)

🚆 Commuter Allowance A monthly stipend to help you get to and from the office.

🏖️ Flexible PTO Take as much time as you need to recharge your batteries.

🍲 Meals & Snacks Lunch, dinner and plenty of snacks, provided daily.

🦖 Your own personal Yoshi

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Cartesia is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

Compensation: $25 – $35 per hour

  • • $25 – $35 per hour
